task_name: Deformable 3D Image Registration Under Respiratory Motion
clinical_objective: Map non-rigid anatomical respiratory deformation between exhale and inhale phases of 4D thoracic CT scans, tracking eight discrete bronchial and vascular landmarks.

research_round.title: Add source depth to the failing registration case

input_data.dataset_citation: Castillo et al., Phys. Med. Biol. 2009. DOI: 10.1088/0031-9155/54/7/003

file_artifacts.description: Full 3D exhale thoracic CT acquisition (T00 phase) with HU array and 4x4 voxel-to-world affine
Full 3D inhale thoracic CT acquisition (T50 phase) with HU array and 4x4 voxel-to-world affine
Eight discrete query landmark positions (q01 to q08) annotated on the exhale source volume

ground_truth.gt_source: DIR-Lab expert radiologist manual consensus landmark coordinates in target inhale volume

task_instruction_prompt: Given the source exhale CT volume, the destination inhale CT volume, and 8 query landmark coordinates, compute the exact 3D non-rigid physical coordinates of the 8 landmarks in the destination inhale CT.

output_contract.format: JSON array of 8 coordinates in destination physical LPS coordinates [x, y, z] in mm

evaluation_rubric.metric: Target Registration Error (TRE) in Euclidean millimeters: ||p_pred - p_gt||
evaluation_rubric.automated_gate: Each point must achieve TRE <= 5.0 mm; overall RMS <= 3.0 mm
evaluation_rubric.visual_adjudication: Qualitative radiological review on structural bifurcations

condition_2d_source_br024.input_scope: Single 2D oblique source slice + 3D target volume
condition_2d_source_br024.benchmark_outcome: FAILED (Out-of-plane respiratory sliding made tracking mathematically under-determined)

condition_3d_source_br028.input_scope: Full 3D source exhale CT + 3D target inhale CT
condition_3d_source_br028.benchmark_outcome: PASSED with Expert Visual Adjudication (q06 sat squarely on the identical anatomical bifurcation ridge)

known_failure_modes_and_traps.description: Landmark q06 scored 6.41 mm, exceeding the 5.0 mm automated cutoff. However, radiological visual review proved both manual truth and Sol's coordinate sat on the exact same anatomical bifurcation ridge. Rigid distance gates without visual inspection discard clinically valid alignments.
